policyID.description: ID of the created policy. Use as policy_id in export_reports.

export_reports.description: Find expense reports in Expensify by date, status, workspace or ID. The result is the list of reports itself (loop over it directly): each has who submitted it, the manager it went to for approval, its total, a link to it and its expenses, with amounts in whole currency units (dollars, not cents). To run a workflow when a report is submitted, use the 'Expense report submitted' trigger instead of calling this on a schedule. Expensify lets no outside app approve or reject a report: the approver does that in Expensify itself, so don't look for an approve or reject action.
export_reports.name: export_reports

parameters.description: Only include reports submitted on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD). Expensify goes by the day a report was submitted, or the day it was created if it hasn't been submitted since (a draft). Required unless you provide a list of report IDs.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: Only include reports submitted on or before this day (YYYY-MM-DD), counted the same way as the start date. The two can be at most a year apart.
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.description: Report IDs to export, separated by commas. Required unless you provide a start date. You can find report IDs in the results of an earlier 'Export expense reports' action.
parameters.name: report_id_list

parameters.description: Optional. Only include reports with this status. SUBMITTED is a report waiting for approval, which comes back with status 'Processing'.
parameters.name: report_state

parameters.description: Only include reports from this policy (workspace). You can get the ID from the 'List Expensify policies' or 'Create Expensify policy' actions.
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.description: Maximum number of reports to export.
parameters.name: limit

returns.description: The step's result is the list of reports itself, not an object with the list inside: loop over the result directly. Empty when no report matches.

approved.description: When the report was approved. Empty until it is.

created.description: When the report was created, as Expensify writes it.

currency.description: The report's currency code, such as USD.

expenseCount.description: How many expenses are on the report.

expenses.description: The report's expenses, each with transactionID, merchant, amount, amountDisplay, currency, category, date, tag, comment, billable, reimbursable and receiptURL.

amount.description: The expense's amount in the report's currency, in whole units (dollars, not cents), such as 350.5.

amountDisplay.description: The amount ready to show a person, with the report's currency, such as '350.50 USD'.

billable.description: true when the expense is to be billed on to a client.

comment.description: The note the submitter wrote on the expense. Empty when there is none.

currency.description: The currency the expense was paid in, such as EUR, which can differ from the report's; amount is already converted.

date.description: The day of the expense, as YYYY-MM-DD.

merchant.description: Where the money was spent, as shown in Expensify.

receiptURL.description: A link to the receipt. Empty when no receipt is attached.

reimbursable.description: true when the submitter is to be paid back for it.

tag.description: The expense's tag. Empty when it has none.

managerEmail.description: Email address of the submitter's manager for this report: the person it was submitted to for approval, or, once approved, the last person who approved it. Empty for a draft.

managerName.description: That manager's full name. Empty when they haven't set a name in Expensify.

policyID.description: That workspace's ID, as 'List policies' gives it.

policyName.description: Name of the Expensify workspace (policy) the report is under.

reportID.description: The report's ID, such as R00bCluvcO4T. Use it as 'report_id_list' in 'Export expense reports' or 'Mark reports as reimbursed'.

reportURL.description: A link that opens the report in Expensify, for the approver or the submitter to click. Empty if Expensify gave no number to build it from.

status.description: Where the report stands: Open (a draft), Processing (submitted, waiting for approval), Approved, Reimbursed or Closed.

submitted.description: When the report was submitted, as Expensify writes it (YYYY-MM-DD, with a time when Expensify gives one). Empty for a draft.

submittedDisplay.description: The day the report was submitted, ready to show a person, such as 'Nov 10, 2026'. Empty for a draft.

submitter.description: Email address of the employee who created and submitted the report.

submitterName.description: The submitter's full name. Empty when they haven't set a name in Expensify; fall back to submitter.

total.description: The report's total as a number in its own currency, in whole units (dollars, not cents), such as 450.75. Compare against this.

totalDisplay.description: The total ready to show a person, with its currency, such as '450.75 USD'.

list_policies.description: List all policies (workspaces) your Expensify account has access to.
list_policies.name: list_policies

parameters.description: Set to true to only include policies where you are an admin.
parameters.name: admin_only

id.description: Policy ID. Use as policy_id in export_reports.

role.description: User's role in this policy (admin, user, auditor).

update_report_status.description: Mark reports as reimbursed. Only Approved reports will be updated; others are skipped. You can get report IDs from the 'Export expense reports' action. This is the only change Expensify lets an outside app make to a report. Expensify lets no outside app approve or reject a report: the approver does that in Expensify itself, so don't look for an approve or reject action.
update_report_status.name: update_report_status

parameters.description: Report IDs to mark as reimbursed, separated by commas. Required unless you provide a start date. You can get report IDs from the 'Export expense reports' action.
parameters.name: report_id_list

parameters.description: Start date filter (YYYY-MM-DD). Required unless you provide a list of report IDs.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: Optional description of the payment source (1-100 characters).
parameters.name: payment_source

reportIDsUpdated.description: List of report IDs that were successfully marked as reimbursed.

description: Automate expense reports and policy management in Expensify.

expensify_report_submitted_trigger.description: Beta. Runs once each time someone submits an expense report in Expensify for approval, with who submitted it, the person it was sent to for approval (managerEmail), its total, a link to it and its expenses. Set 'Minimum total' to run only for larger reports. A report sent back and submitted again runs again. Reports already waiting when the workflow is turned on don't start it. Expensify lets no outside app approve or reject a report, so a workflow can ask the approver and tell people the outcome, but the approver still clicks Approve in Expensify. Checks about once a minute at most; how often follows your workspace plan.
